```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/site.R")
publication <- read_publication("out/release/elo")
format_name <- params$format
stem <- tolower(format_name)
```

**Elo ratings through `r publication$manifest$analysis$as_of`.**
Most recent recorded result: `r publication$manifest$analysis$last_result[[format_name]]`.

## Recent history

The current top ten active teams. Labels give the current rating. Steps show
end-of-day ratings after completed matches; flat sections carry ratings forward.
On narrow screens, scroll the charts sideways to see the complete view.

::: {.chart-scroll role="region" aria-label="Recent ratings chart" tabindex="0"}

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat(sprintf(
  '![Recent %s Elo histories](../out/release/elo/%s.svg){fig-alt="Recent %s ratings with team names and current ratings at line ends."}\n\n',
  format_name, stem, format_name
))
```

:::

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat(sprintf('[Download SVG](../out/release/elo/%s.svg) · [Download PNG](../out/release/elo/%s.png)\n', stem, stem))
```

## Full history by team

Each panel uses the same axes within this format. Teams are selected and ordered
by their current rating, so these panels do not include every historical leader.

::: {.chart-scroll role="region" aria-label="Full rating histories" tabindex="0"}

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat(sprintf(
  '![Full %s Elo histories by team](../out/release/elo/%s_history.svg){fig-alt="Full %s histories for the current top ten active teams, in separate panels with shared axes."}\n\n',
  format_name, stem, format_name
))
```

:::

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat(sprintf('[Download SVG](../out/release/elo/%s_history.svg) · [Download PNG](../out/release/elo/%s_history.png)\n', stem, stem))
```

## Current ratings

Active teams have a rated match in the preceding
`r publication$manifest$analysis$specification$active_days` days. Provisional teams have
fewer than `r publication$manifest$analysis$specification$provisional_matches` rated matches.
Inactive teams remain in the downloadable data.

::: {.ratings-table role="region" aria-label="Current ratings table" tabindex="0"}

```{r}
#| results: asis
knitr::kable(site_ratings(publication, format_name), format = "html", escape = TRUE)
```

:::

These deterministic Elo ratings have no uncertainty intervals. See the
[methods](methods.qmd) for assumptions and limitations, or [download the complete data](data.qmd).
